# Project Guidelines

This is an Angular 21 application (standalone components, no `NgModule`s) named `tabulation-frontend`.

## Build and Test

- Package manager: `npm` (pinned to `npm@11.9.0` in `package.json`).
- Dev server: `npm start` (`ng serve`) → `http://localhost:4200/`.
- Build: `npm run build` (`ng build`), artifacts in `dist/`.
- Tests: `npm test` (`ng test`), runs on the **Vitest** builder (`@angular/build:unit-test`), not Karma/Jasmine.
- Generate code with Angular CLI schematics (`ng generate component ...`) to keep scaffolding consistent instead of hand-writing boilerplate.

## Architecture

- Root app is bootstrapped from [src/main.ts](../src/main.ts) using standalone `App` component ([src/app/app.ts](../src/app/app.ts)) and `appConfig` ([src/app/app.config.ts](../src/app/app.config.ts)).
- Routes are defined in [src/app/app.routes.ts](../src/app/app.routes.ts) and registered via `provideRouter(routes)` in `app.config.ts`. Add new providers (HTTP client, animations, etc.) to `appConfig.providers`, not to a module.
- Global styles live in [src/styles.scss](../src/styles.scss); component styles use SCSS (`styleUrl`, `.scss` files) per the `@schematics/angular:component` config in [angular.json](../angular.json).
- Static assets go in `public/` (served at app root, per the `assets` glob in `angular.json`).

## Conventions

- Components are standalone by default: use `imports: [...]` directly in `@Component`, never declare/import `NgModule`s.
- Prefer Angular `signal()` for local component state (see `App.title` in `app.ts`) over plain fields when state changes over time.
- File naming/schematics follow Angular CLI v21 conventions: no `.component.ts` suffix (e.g. `app.ts`, `app.html`, `app.scss`), matching the defaults generated by `ng generate`.
- Formatting is enforced by Prettier ([.prettierrc](../.prettierrc)): 100 char print width, single quotes, Angular parser for `.html` templates. Run through Prettier/`ng lint` rather than hand-formatting.
- TypeScript is strict-mode; check [tsconfig.json](../tsconfig.json)/[tsconfig.app.json](../tsconfig.app.json) before disabling type-checking features.
